summary: Completed comprehensive testing of IT Asset Management app. All critical bug fixes verified: Asset Manager can now access /api/users endpoint (was returning 403), Assets page loads without 'Failed to load assets' error, Asset Detail page shows asset correctly without 'Asset not found' error. All 34 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing confirmed all roles work correctly with proper RBAC.
critical_code_review_comments: Currency conversion rates are MOCKED (hardcoded in server.py CONVERSION_RATES dict) - not using live exchange rates
seed_data_creation: Seed data already present from previous session
context_for_next_testing_agent: All bug fixes verified. Asset Manager role now has proper access to /api/users endpoint. The app uses JWT authentication with hybrid OAuth support. Multi-currency conversion rates are MOCKED (static dict in server.py). All RBAC permissions working correctly.
